_doc: Append-only retirement ledger for the feature-math grandfather pins (GD-001..GD-010) established by F-047's ownership-lint census and adjudicated in Matrix v1 (docs/analysis/feature-math-divergence-adjudication.md). A pin is retired ONLY in the same change that resolves / renames / deletes its site (its durable_key must then be gone from the code). DELETING an entry here is an auditable governance violation: it breaks the invariant CURRENT_pins UNION RETIRED == ORIGINAL_BASELINE (tests/test_feature_math_lint.py::test_grandfather_set_monotonic). Each retirement must cite finding_id + retired_commit + evidence_artifact.
